title: ChunavIQ: an open, end-to-end verifiable remote-voting research prototype for India
description: Research prototype of an end-to-end verifiable, secret-ballot online election adapted to Indian law, identity infrastructure and scale: deniable revoting with a polling-day override, Aadhaar-or-PAN registration, one national threshold key held in hardware security modules, Terelius-Wikström verifiable shuffles, two independent verifiers (Python and TypeScript), a national-scale capacity model from measured unit costs, and open adversarial dress rehearsals with every request published. Includes the paper (paper/ChunavIQ-paper.pdf). Synthetic data only; not certified or authorised for any binding election. Live demo: https://chunaviq.oglic.com
